questions.question: The ratio of present ages of Raman and Lamba is 7 : 5. After 6 years age of Raman will be 48 years. What is the present age (in years) of Lamba?
questions.solution:
Raman : Lamba = 7 : 5

After 6 years,

Raman + 6 = 48

Raman’s present age = 48 – 6 = 42

Thus, 42 : Lamba = 7 : 5

Lamba = 42 × 5/7 = 30.

Hence, Lamba’s present age is 30 years.

questions.question: If P is 200% of Q and R is 400% of Q, then R is how much percent more than P?
questions.solution:
Given,

P is 200% of Q and R is 400% of Q

P = 200/ 100 × Q

P = 2Q

R = 400 / 100 × Q

R = 4Q

R is more than P by = 4Q - 2Q / 2Q × 100

= 2Q / 2Q × 100

= 100

R is 100 % more than P.

Hence, “100” is the correct answer.

questions.question: When 12 is added to a number, it is equal to 2 times the sum of 4 and the number. Find the number.
questions.solution:
Given,

When 12 is added to a number, it is equal to 2 times the sum of 4 and the number.

Let us consider the number = X

⇒ X + 12 = 2(X + 4)

⇒ X + 12 = 2X + 8

⇒ 2X - X = 12 - 8

∴ X = 4

So, the number X = 4

Hence, the correct answer is "4".

questions.question: A tourist mini bus travelled from Nagpur to Shirdi without stopping. It covered the first 50 miles of the journey at an average speed of 25 mph. What was the bus's average speed (in mph) for the remaining 130 miles, if its overall average speed was 45 mph?
questions.solution:
Time taken to cover 50 miles = Distance ÷ Speed

Time taken to cover 50 mile = 50 ÷ 25

Time taken to cover 50 mile = 2 hours

Now, Total Distance between Nagpur to Shirdi = 50 + 130 = 180 mile

Average speed = 45mph

Time taken to cover 180 mile = 180 ÷ 45 = 4 hours

So, First 50 mile was covered in 2 hours and total time taken is 4 hours 

Therefore remaining distance of 130 mile would have been covered in 2 hours.

So, Average speed for the remaining 130 miles = 130 ÷ 2 = **65mph**

Hence, **option 1** is the correct answer.

questions.question: Anuj's salary is twice the salary of Manoj. Ramnathan's salary is half the salary of Vikram. Manoj's salary is Rs. 15,000 less than the salary of Ramnathan. If the salary of Anuj is Rs. 20,000, what is the total salary of all the four persons?
questions.solution:
Anuj's salary is twice the salary of Manoj. 

Let the salary of Manoj be m.

So, salary of Anuj = 2m

If the **salary of** **Anuj is Rs. 20,000**.

⇒ 2m = 20000

⇒ m = 20000/2 = 10000

Therefore, **salary of Manoj = 10000**

Manoj's salary is Rs. 15,000 less than the salary of Ramnathan.

Which means the salary of Ramnathan is 15000 more than the salary of Manoj.

**Salary of Ramnathan = 10000 + 15000 = 25000**

Ramnathan's salary is half the salary of Vikram.

**Salary of Vikram = 2 × 25000 = 50000**

The total salary of all the four persons = 20000 + 10000 + 25000 + 50000 = 105000

Hence, '**Rs. 1,05,000**' is the correct answer.

questions.question: If the ratio of the present ages of P and Q is 3 : 5 and the sum of their ages 4 years ago was 64, then what was the ratio of their ages 4 years ago?
questions.solution:
The ratio of the present ages of P and Q = 3 : 5

Let P’s present age be 3x and Q’s present age be 5x

The sum of their present ages = 64 (sum of ages 4 years ago) + 8

3x + 5x = 72 years

8x = 72 → x = 9

The present age of P = 3x → 3 × 9 → 27 years

The present age of Q = 5x → 5 × 9 → 45 years

The ratio of their ages 4 years ago = (27 – 4)/(45 – 4)

→ 23/41

Hence, the ratio of ages of P and Q, 4 years ago, is ’23 : 41’.

⇒ X + 3X - 3 = 65

⇒ 4X - 3 = 65

⇒ 4X = 68

⇒** X = 17**

Hence, the correct answer is **"17".**

questions.question: In a class, if 3 students are absent, then the rest of the students can be divided equally into 7 groups and if 7 students are absent, then the rest of the students can be divided equally into 9 groups. How many students are present in the class?
questions.solution:
Let, the total number of students are x.

If 3 students are absent, then the rest of the students can be divided equally into 7 groups.

Equal parts are (x - 3)/7

If 7 students are absent, then the rest of the students can be divided equally into 9 groups. 

Equal parts are (x - 7)/9

According to the question,

(x - 3)/7 = (x - 7)/9 + 4

⇒ (9x - 27 - 7x + 49)/ 63 = 4

⇒ 2x + 22 = 63 × 4

⇒ 2x = 252 - 22

⇒ 2x = 230

⇒ x = 115.

Hence, the correct answer is **"115"**.

If 7 students are absent, then the rest of the students can be divided equally into 9 groups. 

Equal parts are (87 - 7)/9 = **80 does not divide by 9.**

__Option (4____): __101

If 3 students are absent, then the rest of the students can be divided equally into 7 groups. 

Equal parts are (101 - 3)/7 = 98/7 = 14.

If 7 students are absent, then the rest of the students can be divided equally into 9 groups.

questions.question: A number when added to 4 times to itself, gets equal to 10 times to its predecessor. Find the number.
questions.solution:
Let the number is x

**1) A number when added to 4 times to itself.**

=> x + 4x = 5x

**2) Gets equal to 10 times to its predecessor.**

=> 5x = 10(x - 1)

=> 5x = 10x – 10

=> 10x – 5x = 10 

=> 5x = 10

=> x = 2

Hence, **“2”** is that number.

questions.question: The sum of four numbers A, B, C and D is 147. The ratio of C and D is 3 ∶ 5, respectively. D is five times A. C is twice of B. What is the value of B ?
questions.solution:
Given:

1) A, B, C and D is 147

**=> A + B + C +D = 147 --------- (i)**

2) The ratio of C and D is 3 ∶ 5.

=> C : D = 3 : 5

Let the common factor between C and D is ‘x’

**So, C = 3x; and D = 5x ****--------- (ii)**

3) D is five times A. C is twice of B.

=> D = 5A and C = 2B

Putting the value of C and D from eq. (ii)

=> 5x = 5A and 3x = 2B

**=> A = x and B = 1.5x** **---------- (iii)**

Putting the value of A and B from eq. (iii) and C and D from eq. (ii) in eq (i)

=> x + 1.5x + 3x + 5x = 147

=> 10.5x = 147

=> x = 147 ÷ 10.5

=> x = 14

Since B = 1.5x

So, B = 1.5 × 14 = 21

Hence, The value of B is **“21”.**

questions.question: When a number is added to its previous number and another number that is two times its previous number, the sum of these three numbers is 61. Find the number.
questions.solution:
Let the number be 'a'.

According to question:

a + (a - 1) + 2(a - 1) = 61

⇒ a + a - 1 + 2a - 2 = 61

⇒ 4a - 3 = 61

⇒ 4a = 61 + 3

⇒ 4a = 64

⇒ a = 64 ÷ 4

⇒ a = 16

Hence, '**16**' is the correct answer.

questions.question: When a natural number X is added to its next natural number Y and another natural number that is five times its next natural number Y, the sum of these three numbers is 104. Find the number X.
questions.solution:
Given,

When a natural number X is added to its next natural number Y and another natural number that is five times its next natural number Y.

First natural number = X

Next natural number Y = X + 1

Another natural number that is five times its next natural number Y = 5(X + 1)

Sum of these three numbers = 104

⇒ X + X + 1 + 5(X + 1) = 104

⇒ X + X + 1 + 5X + 5 = 104

⇒ 7X + 6 = 104

⇒ 7X = 98

**⇒ X = 14**

Hence, the correct answer is **"14".**

Savings of Rohit = 20% of X

The amount saved each month is ₹14,620 by Rohit → 20% × X = 14620

⇒ (20/100) × X = 14620

⇒ (1/5) × X = 14620

⇒ X = 73100/-

∴ As, we considered 85% of total income = X/-

Here, 85% of total income = 73100/-

⇒ 100% of total income = 100 × (73100/85)

⇒ 100% of total income = 100 × 860

∴ Total monthly income of Rohit = 86000/-

Hence, the correct answer is **"₹86,000".**

 7X + (7X + 7) + (7X + 14) + (7X + 21) + (7X + 28) = 455

questions.question: Manoj starts from his home and reaches the temple in 7 hours. He travels 1/4 th of the total distance at a speed of 10 km/h and the remaining distance at 12 km/h. Find the distance between his home and the temple.
questions.solution:
Given,

Manoj starts from his home and reaches the temple in 7 hours.

⇒ Total time taken = 7 hours.

He travels 1/4 th of the total distance at a speed of 10 km/h and the remaining distance at 12 km/h.

Total distance = 4x km.

**Total time taken = D₁/S₁ + D₂/S₂ **

He travels 1/4 th of the total distance at a speed of 10 km/h.

D₁ = 4x/4 = x km

D₂ = 4x - x = 3x km

S₁ = 10 km/h

S₂ = 12 km/h.

∴ Total time taken = D1/S1 + D2/S2 

⇒ 7 = x/10 + 3x/12

⇒ 7 = x/10 + x/4

LCM of 10, 4 is 20

⇒ 7 = (2x + 5x)/20

⇒ 7 = 7x/20

⇒ x = 20 

∴ The total distance = 4x = 4 × 20 = 80 km

Hence, the correct answer is **"80 km".**

questions.question: A number is subtracted from 4 times of it and then, the number obtained is added to its (the resultant’s) next number. If this gives the answer as 91, what was the original number?
questions.solution:
**Let the number is ‘x’**

Given:

**1) A number is subtracted from 4 times of it**

=> 4x – x = 3x

**2) Then, the number obtained is added to its (the resultant’s) next number the answer as 91.**

=> 3x + (3x + 1) = 91

=> 6x = 91 – 1

=> 6x = 90

=> x = 90 / 6

=> x = 15

Hence, **‘15’** was the original number.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__**

Now, check the options (4):

The number is 15

The number is subtracted from 4 times it and then → (15 × 4) - 15 = 60 - 15 = 45

The number obtained is added to its (the resultant’s) next number → 45 + 46 = 91 (Proved)

Hence, ‘15’ was the original number.

questions.question: Abhay's uncle sent him some mangoes from Konkan. If he was to eat some specific number of mangoes every day, they would have lasted for 60 days. But, Abhay's cousin Rajiv came to spend the holidays with him and both of them finished the mangoes in 36 days. If Rajiv alone was to eat the mangoes, then how many days would they have lasted?
questions.solution:
Given :

1) Abhay eat mangoes in 60 days.

2) Abhay and Rajiv eat mangoes in 36 days.

**Total work = LCM of 60 days and 36 days.**

**Total work = 180**

We know that,

**Total work = efficiency × days**

Efficiency = Total work ÷ days

**The efficiency of Abhay = Total work ÷ days**

Efficiency of Abhay = 180 ÷ 60 = 3

**The efficiency of Abhay and Rajiv = Total work ÷ days**

Efficiency of Abhay and Rajiv = 180 ÷ 36 = 5

**The efficiency of Rajiv =** Efficiency of Abhay and Rajiv - Efficiency of Abhay

Efficiency of Rajiv = 5 – 3 = 2

 We know that,

Total work = efficiency × days

Days = Total work ÷ efficiency

Days = 180 ÷ 2

Days = 90

Hence, If Rajiv eats mangoes alone he takes **“90”** days.

questions.question: There are two computer rooms, Lab A and Lab B. If 10 students are sent from Lab A to Lab B, then the number of students in each room will be the same. If 26 students are sent from Lab B to Lab A, then the number of students in Lab A will be triple the number of students in Lab B. The number of students in Lab B is:
questions.solution:
There are two computer rooms, Lab A and Lab B.

Let us consider, 

Students in Lab A = X

Students in Lab B = Y

If 10 students are sent from Lab A to Lab B, then the number of students in each room will be the same.

⇒ X - 10 = Y + 10

⇒ X - Y = 20 ............ (1)

If 26 students are sent from Lab B to Lab A, then the number of students in Lab A will be triple the number of students in Lab B.

⇒ X + 26 = 3(Y - 26)

⇒ X + 26 = 3Y - 78

⇒ X = 3Y - 104 .......... (2)

Substitute eqn (2) in equ (1) So, we get

⇒ X - Y = 20

⇒ 3Y - 104 - Y = 20

⇒ 2Y = 124

⇒ Y = 62

∴ Here, Number of students in Lab B taken as Y = 62

Hence, the correct answer is **"62".**

questions.question: Two years ago, T was twice as old as P. P is thrice as old as R. In five years, P will be 29. What is the present age of T?
questions.solution:
Given: Two years ago, T was twice as old as P. P is thrice as old as R. In five years, P will be 29. 

According to the question,

Two years ago, T was twice as old as P.

 
• T - 2 = 2 × (P - 2); _________(i)

At present, P is thrice as old as R.

 
• P = 3 × R; ____________(ii)

In five years, P will be 29. 

 
• P + 5 = 29
 
• P = 29 - 5 = 24 years

Now, by substituting the age of P, we get,

 
• T - 2 = 2 × (P - 2)
 
• T - 2 = 2 × (24 - 2)
 
• T - 2 = 2 × 22
 
• T = 44 + 2
 
• T = 46 years

Hence, the present age of T is **46 years.**
